en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European town in a valley, dominated by a hill crowned with a large medieval-style castle that has cylindrical towers with conical roofs and small spires. The castle stands on a rocky, wooded outcrop above tightly packed townhouses and industrial buildings with steep gabled roofs. In the foreground there appears to be a lumber yard or construction site with stacked boards. Rolling fields and low hills extend into the distance. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.
